scenario.title: Research study: how students take part in clubs
scenario.intro: A researcher from the sociology department is interviewing students about how they take part in clubs and student organizations.

questions.text: To start, could you tell me whether you belong to any clubs or student groups, and how you first heard about them?
Can you describe an event organized by students that you went to, and what made it memorable or disappointing for you?
Some people think universities should give student clubs more money, even if that means less funding for other campus services. What is your opinion, and why?
How do you think student clubs will change over the next ten years, especially as more activities move online?
